dct_description_sm: The questionnaire aims to describe the herd demographics and antimicrobial use in calves on farms enrolled in the study. It highlights the case-specific indicators used by the dairy producers when they decide to treat calves with antimicrobials for diarrhea and respiratory disease.
dct_title_s: Supplementary data for: Cross-sectional study of antimicrobial use and treatment decision making for pre-weaned Canadian dairy calves
